• Bill Haisten found a spot-on comparison for this Cowboy defense — the 2007 Cowboy defense.

In 2007, OSU blew a 21-point, fourth-quarter lead and lost 38-35 to Texas at Boone Pickens Stadium. In Norman, OU rocked for 307 rushing yards in a 49-17 Bedlam blowout.
The 2007 Cowboys were 103rd nationally in total defense.
In advance of Saturday’s noon challenge at Kansas State, the 2026 Cowboys are No. 3 nationally in scoring, No. 3 nationally in passing yards and No. 3 nationally in total offense.

Total defense? The 2026 Cowboys look a lot like the 2007 Cowboys. The 2026 defense is 103rd nationally in yards allowed. [Tulsa World]
